caption:
You can always find ten things to fix. You can only afford to fix one well this quarter.

Growth Terminal ranks all twelve places growth gets stuck and tells you which one is yours right now — so your team points at a single target instead of ten.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: If everything is a priority, nothing is. Which one is yours?
